Your browser does not support the video tag. Activate Fellows set a high bar for innovation and impact. Fellow Success Stories Where scientists become leaders of world-changing ventures. Activate's flagship fellowship program was the first fellowship for entrepreneurial scientists—providing the mindsets, skills, networks, and support needed to turn breakthrough hard tech into real-world impact. Through Activate’s expanded global programming, we’re supporting science entrepreneurs at every stage of their journey, offering the most comprehensive programming in the space.
